testimonials.title: Success Stories in
testimonials.description: Hear from professionals who have advanced their careers and mastered project management through our accredited training programs.

items.name: Engineer Rami Abu Bakr
items.role: Al Ramz Construction Projects Company | Kingdom of Saudi Arabia
items.content: My sincere thanks and appreciation to Dr. Talat and the team accompanying the course. Frankly, it was a very special training course on a personal level. To be honest, the goal was not only to pass the exam and obtain the certificate, but rather my goal was to learn and apply project management in the real world, given our work as engineers and site managers.

items.name: Dr. Faten Al-Buaishi Al-Kilani
items.role: Lecturer at the Faculty of Law, University of Tripoli | Libya
items.content: I enrolled in Dr. Talaat Alawady’s training program on professional project management, believing the scope of the information and skills I would receive would be beyond the scope of the program. I wondered what benefits I could gain from a specialty so far removed from this training program, as I had previously believed. I later discovered, while lecturing at law schools in Libyan universities, that I had acquired numerous significant skills that refined my approach to giving and presenting.

items.name: Faisal Al-Shabahi
items.content: Many thanks to Trainer Talat Al-Awadi for this course (Professional Project Management). It played a significant role in broadening my understanding and knowledge of project management, addressing real-world scenarios with wisdom and effective management—an approach that yields numerous practical benefits. I also extend my gratitude to the team at the Dar Al-Ibdaa Center for their outstanding efforts, as well as to my fellow trainees; it was a pleasure working and collaborating with them throughout the course.

faq.question: Who is Creativity House?
faq.answer: Creativity House is an accredited project management training provider and PMI Authorized Training Partner. We deliver PMP® and PMI-RMP® programs, corporate training, and professional development for individuals and organizations.

faq.question: Is Creativity House PMI-authorized?
faq.answer: Yes. Creativity House is a PMI Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our PMP preparation courses use PMI-approved materials and qualified instructors, and provide the contact hours needed for the PMP exam application.

courses.intro: Creativity House is a PMI Authorized Training Partner offering project management courses for professionals who want to earn PMP® or PMI-RMP® credentials. Choose live virtual cohorts with instructor-led sessions, recorded academies for self-paced study, or exam simulators to rehearse under real test conditions. Our PMP preparation pathways include the 35 contact hours of project management education required for the exam application, with content available in Arabic and English for learners across the MENA region.

choose.title: Live training
choose.body: Instructor-led virtual cohorts with scheduled sessions, Q&A, and peer accountability — ideal if you want structure and live coaching toward the PMP exam.

choose.title: Recorded academy
choose.body: Self-paced video libraries and study plans you can complete around work. Best when you need flexibility while still covering PMI-aligned domains.

choose.title: Exam simulator
choose.body: Timed practice exams and question banks that mirror PMP-style items. Use alone for drill, or alongside a live or recorded program.

faq.question: What is PMP®?
faq.answer: PMP® (Project Management Professional) is PMI’s globally recognized credential for project managers. It validates that you can lead projects using standardized processes, people skills, and business awareness aligned with PMI standards.

faq.question: Which course should I choose?
faq.answer: Choose live training for scheduled coaching, a recorded academy for flexible self-study, or a simulator if you mainly need exam practice. Many learners combine a full program with simulator access. Contact us if you are unsure which path fits your timeline.

faq.question: Do I get 35 contact hours?
faq.answer: Our PMP preparation programs are designed to provide the 35 contact hours of project management education required to apply for the PMP exam, delivered as a PMI Authorized Training Partner.

faq.question: Is training available in Arabic?
faq.answer: Yes. Creativity House delivers programs in Arabic and English so professionals across the MENA region can learn in the language that works best for them.

faq.question: Is this course accredited by PMI?
faq.answer: Creativity House is a PMI Authorized Training Partner (ATP). This course provides the 35 contact hours of project management education required to apply for the PMP exam.

faq.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
faq.answer: Per PMI, you need 35 contact hours of project management education, plus either 36 months of project experience with a four-year degree, or 60 months of project experience with a secondary diploma.

faq.question: Is the course available in Arabic?
How much does the course cost?
faq.answer: See the live price in the pricing card on this page. Amounts may vary by delivery mode (live, recorded, or simulator).

faq.question: How do I register?
faq.answer: Choose a delivery mode and batch if shown, then click the buy or enroll button on this page. You can also send a question via the Course Inquiry form.
